russell.title: Walter Russell's Periodic Table of Elements
russell.note: Russell arranges elements by octave number (1–9) mapped to the electromagnetic spectrum. Each octave contains a 'wavelength group' and a 'frequency group'. Elements are positioned by their vibratory rate, not just atomic number.

classification_legend.W: Wavelength group (generative, accumulating, building upward through octaves)

combined.title: Combined Periodic Table — Standard + Russell Overlay
combined.note: Each element mapped to both its standard IUPAC position and Russell octave/frequency position. The overlay cell shows both coordinate systems side by side.
